Hollow Serenity#000.src: Something seems off in the abandoned manor at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Hollow Serenity#000.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の廃屋敷の様子がおかしい

Hollow Serenity#002.src: A cold touch shivers down your spine...
Hollow Serenity#002.dst: 背筋に冷たい感覚が走り身震いする…

Hollow Serenity#003.src: It's a pile of charred letters... You can still make out some of the words, though.
Hollow Serenity#003.dst: 焦げた手紙の束だ……とはいえ、いくつかの言葉はまだ読み取れる。

Hollow Serenity#004.src: It's a pile of charred letters... You can still make out some of the words, though.
Hollow Serenity#004.dst: 焦げた手紙の束だ……とはいえ、いくつかの言葉はまだ読み取れる。

Hollow Serenity#005.src: G-r---... I cannot ignore it --- longer...
Hollow Serenity#005.dst: うっ…これ以上無視できない…

Hollow Serenity#006.src: ...love you too much... -- tired of Yorman...
Hollow Serenity#006.dst: …愛しすぎて…――Yormanにはもううんざり…

Hollow Serenity#007.src: ... doesn't have to know. We can — happy together... y--r's truly, -----in...
Hollow Serenity#007.dst: …知る必要はない。私たちは――二人で幸せに過ごせる……敬具…

Hollow Serenity#008.src: There's a book sticking out of here with the number '{~}' drawn on it...
Hollow Serenity#008.dst: ここから数字の'{~}'が書かれた本がはみ出している…

Hollow Serenity#009.src: It's a touching story... but you don't read it. It's not nice to ignore someone who's looking at you.
Hollow Serenity#009.dst: 心温まる話だけど……それを読まないなんて。自分を見つめている人を無視するのは、よくないことだ。

Hollow Serenity#010.src: The drawer is sealed with a tight rope. Something sharp should be able to cut it.
Hollow Serenity#010.dst: 引き出しは丈夫なロープで縛られている。鋭利なものであれば、それを切ることができるはずだ。

Hollow Serenity#012.src: One of the books pops out quite glaringly. You decide to check it out...
Hollow Serenity#012.dst: ある一冊の本がひときわ目立っている。それを手に取ってみることにした……

Hollow Serenity#013.src: It's a book detailing one of the greatest board games of all time. It sounds quite fun.
Hollow Serenity#013.dst: これは、史上最高のボードゲームの一つについて詳しく解説した本だ。かなり楽しそう。

Hollow Serenity#014.src: The door is locked. A key is required.
Hollow Serenity#014.dst: 鍵がかかっている。開けるには鍵が必要だ。

Hollow Serenity#015.src: It's a grossly overexaggerated novel about the {p} war.
Hollow Serenity#015.dst: これは{p}戦争を題材にした、ひどく大げさに誇張された小説だ。

Hollow Serenity#016.src: The chest is tightly locked. The lock itself appears to require a combination of four letters, all in a specific order...
Hollow Serenity#016.dst: この箱はしっかりと鍵がかけられている。鍵自体は4文字の組み合わせが必要のようで、その文字はすべて特定の順序で並んでいるようだ……

Hollow Serenity#017.src: ...You don't have the slightest clue as to what the passcode could be.
Hollow Serenity#017.dst: …そのパスコードが何なのか、まったく見当もつかない。

Hollow Serenity#018.src: This appears to be a letter explaining who the Faltachs are...
Hollow Serenity#018.dst: これはFaltachs家について記された手紙のようだ…

Hollow Serenity#019.src: According to the text, the Faltachs are a family of nobles that have been apart of the forest for decades, more or less having personal control over the area.
Hollow Serenity#019.dst: 本文によると、Faltachs家は数十年にわたりこの森と密接に関わってきた貴族の一族であり、この地域を事実上独自に支配してきた。

Hollow Serenity#020.src: They collected taxes from residents of the forest, and were an integral part of the region's politics... But considering the state of this manor, that isn't the case anymore.
Hollow Serenity#020.dst: 彼らは森の住民から税金を徴収し、この地域の政治において欠かせない存在だった……しかし、この荘園の現状を見る限り、もはやそうではないようだ。

Hollow Serenity#021.src: As of {~} AP, The family consisted of Yorman Faltach, Katarin Faltach, and their infant daughter Eileen.
Hollow Serenity#021.dst: {~} APの時点で、この家族はYorman Faltach、Katarin Faltach、そして生後間もない娘のEileenで構成されていた。

Hollow Serenity#022.src: It's apparently about a boy who's scared by the sound of an owl hooting.
Hollow Serenity#022.dst: どうやら、フクロウの鳴き声に怯えてしまう少年が主人公の物語らしい。

Hollow Serenity#023.src: Pick the first letter of the passcode:
Hollow Serenity#023.dst: パスコードの最初の文字を選ぼう:

Hollow Serenity#024.src: That was incorrect... It looks like you need to start over again.
Hollow Serenity#024.dst: 不正解…どうやら最初からやり直す必要がありそうだ。

Hollow Serenity#026.src: Pick the second letter of the passcode:
Hollow Serenity#026.dst: パスコードの2文字目を選ぼう:

Hollow Serenity#027.src: Pick the third letter of the passcode:
Hollow Serenity#027.dst: パスコードの3文字目を選ぼう:

Hollow Serenity#028.src: Pick what's obviously the fourth letter of the passcode:
Hollow Serenity#028.dst: パスコードの4文字目と明らかにわかる文字を選ぼう:

Hollow Serenity#029.src: That was incorrect, despite the fact that the last letter was obviously R... It looks like you need to start over again.
Hollow Serenity#029.dst: 最後の文字が明らかにRなのに不正解…最初からやり直す必要がありそうだ。

Hollow Serenity#030.src: You see a few books regarding the histories of {p} and {p}, but not much else noteworthy.
Hollow Serenity#030.dst: {p}と{p}に関する本が数冊見受けられるが、それ以外に特筆すべきものはあまりない。

Hollow Serenity#031.src: This bookshelf sure seems like an an interesting one! You find books of various kind.
Hollow Serenity#031.dst: この本棚、確かに興味深い…いろんな種類の本が並んでいる。

Hollow Serenity#032.src: There's one about the ancient tales of Gylia, another regarding Remikas' victory... and even a book about dreaming?
Hollow Serenity#032.dst: Gyliaの古代の伝説に関する本が1冊、Remikasの勝利に関する本がもう1冊……それに、夢についての本まであるの？

Hollow Serenity#033.src: A bunch of notes are scribbled on all of them.
Hollow Serenity#033.dst: どれにもたくさんのメモが走り書きされている。

Hollow Serenity#034.src: You begin to read the letters inside of the drawer...
Hollow Serenity#034.dst: 引き出しの中にある手紙を読み始める…

Hollow Serenity#035.src: Eileen, Eileen... That girl never listens to me! Her own mother!
Hollow Serenity#035.dst: Eileen、Eileen……あの子は私の言うことを全然聞いてくれない！自分の母親なのに！

Hollow Serenity#036.src: Every day, I find books sticking out of the bookshelves! And she keeps on coloring random letters in them...
Hollow Serenity#036.dst: 毎日、本棚から本がはみ出しているのを見つけるんです！それに、彼女は本の中にある文字に色付けをし続けていて……

Hollow Serenity#037.src: She told me that those are her favorite books, there's some sort of 'clue' in them for... something.
Hollow Serenity#037.dst: 彼女はそれらが自分の大好きな本だと言って、その本には……何かについての'手がかり'が隠されているんだって。

Hollow Serenity#038.src: I can't comprehend her reasons for doing that... Can't she come up with something that's less of a nuisance for the maids?
Hollow Serenity#038.dst: なぜそんなことをしたのか、私には理解できない……メイドたちにとって、もう少し迷惑にならないような方法を考えられないものだろうか？

Hollow Serenity#039.src: How many bookshelves does this manor have!?
Hollow Serenity#039.dst: この邸宅には、一体本棚がいくつあるんだ！？

Hollow Serenity#041.src: It's an old letter. The edges are stained with some strange, dark liquid...
Hollow Serenity#041.dst: 古い手紙だ。端には、何か奇妙な黒い液体が染み込んでいる……

Hollow Serenity#042.src: Garvan... he worries me more and more by the day. My sweet, beloved Garvan.
Hollow Serenity#042.dst: Garvan……日ごとにますます心配になってくる。私の愛しい、最愛のGarvan。

Hollow Serenity#043.src: I remember, at the beginning... Yorman had hired Garvan out of concern for this 'Decay' plaguing the land. We told him that he must find a cure for the Decay before it subjugated the entire forest.
Hollow Serenity#043.dst: 覚えているよ、当初のこと……Yormanは、この地を蝕む'腐朽'を懸念してGarvanを雇ったんだ。私たちは彼に腐朽が森全体を支配してしまう前に、その治療法を見つけなければならないと伝えたんだ。

Hollow Serenity#044.src: Over time... Well, I suppose love can corrupt. How else would I have...
Hollow Serenity#044.dst: 時が経つにつれて……まあ、愛ってのは人を堕落させるものなのかもしれない。そうでなければ、どうして私が……

Hollow Serenity#045.src: Fallen in love with Garvan and forsook my own marriage under the nose of my husband and my beloved daughter-
Hollow Serenity#045.dst: Garvanに恋をして、夫や愛する娘の目の前で自分の結婚生活を捨ててしまった――

Hollow Serenity#046.src: But I digress. Garvan's done great research on this Decay, but... recently, he's changed. Something's wrong with him.
Hollow Serenity#046.dst: 話がそれてしまった。Garvanはこの腐朽について素晴らしい研究を行ってきたが……最近、彼は変わってしまった。彼に何かおかしいところがある。

Hollow Serenity#047.src: His eyes are glazed and dull. His tone of voice is... disturbing. He's made very little progress on the cure we tasked him with, and... I don't know what to do.
Hollow Serenity#047.dst: 彼の目は虚ろで、生気がない。その口調は……不気味だ。我々が彼に任せた治療法の研究は、ほとんど進展が見られないし……どうすればいいのか分からない。

Hollow Serenity#048.src: I suppose... I should just leave him be for the time being. Surely me butting into his work would just make him even worse, no?
Hollow Serenity#048.dst: まあ……とりあえずは、彼を放っておいたほうがいいだろう。私が彼の仕事に口出ししたら、かえって状況を悪化させるだけだろうし、そうじゃない?

Hollow Serenity#049.src: Besides, if he ever gets too bad, he lives just east of the manor. I can be there for him if I need to, right?
Hollow Serenity#049.dst: それに、もし彼の状態がひどくなったら、彼は邸宅のすぐ東に住んでいるし。必要なら、私が駆けつけてあげられるでしょ?

Hollow Serenity#050.src: That was... unsettling. Nevertheless, you should head east of the manor for any sign of where this Garvan person might live. You recall there being a village around there...
Hollow Serenity#050.dst: それは……気味が悪い。とはいえ、このGarvanという人物がどこに住んでいるのか手がかりを探すため、屋敷の東へ向かうべきだ。あの辺りに村があったことを覚えているだろう……

Hollow Serenity#053.src: Head to the forest village east of the manor at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and ask its residents about a man named Garvan.
Hollow Serenity#053.dst: 屋敷の東、[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の森の村へ行き、Garvan という男について住人に聞く。

Hollow Serenity#054.src: ...That was odd. Who was that? ...Regardless, you shouldn't stray away from heading to the village.
Hollow Serenity#054.dst: …あれは奇妙だった。あれは誰だったんだろう？ …とにかく、村へ向かう途中で道を外れてはいけない。

Hollow Serenity#055.src: Hello soldier! Welcome to this... hick village. I presume the neighbor's kid has been stealing apples again, hmm?
Hollow Serenity#055.dst: こんにちは兵隊さん！この…田舎村へようこそ。どうせまた隣の子がリンゴを盗んだんでしょ？
Hollow Serenity#055.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#056.src: Oh, Ann... Your voice is so delicate, so soothing that- Ah, soldier! Are you here for something... or someone?
Hollow Serenity#056.dst: ああ、Ann…君の声は繊細で心安らぐ――おっと、兵隊さん！何か用かい…それとも誰かを探して？
Hollow Serenity#056.speaker: Qunit

Hollow Serenity#060.src: We're the best couple in the entire forest! Nobody can match our love!
Hollow Serenity#060.dst: 私たち、森一番のお似合い夫婦なの！誰にも負けない愛よ！
Hollow Serenity#060.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#061.src: Do you have someone special to you like we are, human? A handsome little man? Or a pretty little woman? Or... neither? We won't judge.
Hollow Serenity#061.dst: 人間、君にも僕らみたいな特別な人はいるかい？素敵な男性？綺麗な女性？それとも…どちらでもない？責めはしないよ。
Hollow Serenity#061.speaker: Qunit

Hollow Serenity#062.src: Absolutely we're married! Everyone finds it very hard to believe, but I don't blame them! It's a tough would... we... live in, yes!
Hollow Serenity#062.dst: もちろん結婚してるわ！みんな信じられないって言うけど、責めないわ！厳しい世の…中に…生きてるんだもの、うん！
Hollow Serenity#062.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#063.src: Four years it has been, since we kissed under the starry sky amidst the blossoming fields near {p}. I can still see it in my dreams...
Hollow Serenity#063.dst: もう四年になる。{p} 近くの花咲く野原で、星空の下で口づけを交わしてから。今でも夢に見るよ…
Hollow Serenity#063.speaker: Qunit

Hollow Serenity#064.src: Yeah, what Qunit said! We've been married for {~} years! And soon that number is gonna go up to infinity!
Hollow Serenity#064.dst: そう、Qunit の言う通り！結婚して {~} 年よ！その数字もすぐ無限大になるわ！
Hollow Serenity#064.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#066.src: Oh! Sorry about Qunit, he doesn't like thinking about our... circumstances.
Hollow Serenity#066.dst: あっ！ごめんね、Qunit は私たちの…境遇を考えるのが嫌いなの。
Hollow Serenity#066.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#067.dst: annがゆっくりとこちらに囁きかける…

Hollow Serenity#068.src: We're in heavy debt to the government. We can't afford to live anywhere else.
Hollow Serenity#068.dst: 政府に多額の借金があって、他の場所には住めないの。
Hollow Serenity#068.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#069.src: This forest is also safe from their prying eyes, which has inarguably caused certain... opinions to fester here...
Hollow Serenity#069.dst: この森なら政府の目も届かないし、そのせいで間違いなくある種の…思想がここで膿んでて…
Hollow Serenity#069.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#070.src: Yeah, yeah! It doesn't matter why we're here, soldier! Haha! We're here, and we love each other! That's all that matters. Yes.
Hollow Serenity#070.dst: はいはい！ここにいる理由なんてどうでもいいのよ兵隊さん！あはは！私たちはここにいて、愛し合ってる！それが全て。うん。
Hollow Serenity#070.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#071.src: Yes, actually. There's something dark to the north. There are parasites in it. It's dangerous.
Hollow Serenity#071.dst: ああ、実はある。北に何か暗いものがある。中には寄生虫がいる。危険だ。
Hollow Serenity#071.speaker: Qunit

Hollow Serenity#072.src: O-oh! Don't worry about what Qunit's saying. He's been having this recurring dream of a big worm creature laying dark eggs inside of a weird cave. He won't let it go, either!
Hollow Serenity#072.dst: え、えっと！Qunit の話は気にしないで。変な洞窟で大きな虫の化け物が黒い卵を産む夢を何度も見てるの。しかも全然忘れようとしないのよ！
Hollow Serenity#072.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#073.src: It's not a fantasy, Ann. I've told you this.
Hollow Serenity#073.dst: 空想じゃないよ、Ann。前にも言っただろう。
Hollow Serenity#073.speaker: Qunit

Hollow Serenity#074.src: Shh, honey... we'll talk about this later, not in front of the soldier... Who probably has much more important things to do, hah!
Hollow Serenity#074.dst: しーっ、あなた…その話は後でね、兵隊さんの前じゃなくて…きっともっと大事な用があるのよ、ねっ！
Hollow Serenity#074.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#077.src: See? We're both on the same wavelength! Neither of us have met this person! We're... so in love, darling...
Hollow Serenity#077.dst: ほらね？私たち息ぴったり！二人ともその人に会ったことないの！私たち…ほんとに愛し合ってるわ、あなた…
Hollow Serenity#077.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#079.src: An outsider? Here? We don't get many of you people often...
Hollow Serenity#079.dst: よそ者？ここに？お前らみたいなのは滅多に来ないんだが…
Hollow Serenity#079.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#081.src: The name's Aunoa. I'm a farmer. Not much else to say.
Hollow Serenity#081.dst: Aunoa だ。農夫をしてる。他に言うことはない。
Hollow Serenity#081.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#082.src: I've got a kid, but he doesn't live here. His mother took him away to live in {p} a while back. Don't have any other family.
Hollow Serenity#082.dst: 子供が一人いるが、ここには住んでない。少し前に母親が {p} へ連れて行った。他に家族はいない。
Hollow Serenity#082.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#083.src: This village is the only family I have.
Hollow Serenity#083.dst: この村だけが俺の家族だ。
Hollow Serenity#083.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#084.src: It's my home. The people I know and trust live here. It's a dump, but it's still my damn home.
Hollow Serenity#084.dst: ここは俺の家だ。知ってる奴、信頼できる奴が住んでる。ゴミ溜めだが、それでも俺の家なんだよ。
Hollow Serenity#084.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#085.src: Wish I could leave, though. This forest is awful. The crops are in horrible condition. Government doesn't give a damn about us either.
Hollow Serenity#085.dst: まあ、出て行けたらとは思うがな。この森はひどい。作物もボロボロだ。政府も俺たちのことなんざ気にしちゃいない。
Hollow Serenity#085.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#086.src: Apparently the House of Talor has a massive crypt somewhere underneath its floors. Rich people used to be buried there.
Hollow Serenity#086.dst: House of Talor の床下のどこかに、でかい地下墓所があるらしい。昔は金持ちがそこに埋葬されてた。
Hollow Serenity#086.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#087.src: There's probably some rare artifacts down there. Go take a look if you want, but everyone here has tried and failed to find it.
Hollow Serenity#087.dst: 珍しい遺物もあるだろうな。見たきゃ行けばいいが、ここの連中はみんな探して見つけられなかった。
Hollow Serenity#087.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#088.src: Yes, I do. But I probably can't stop you. Humans like you have a thing for invading privacy whenever you feel like it.
Hollow Serenity#088.dst: ああ、気にする。だが止められんだろうな。お前ら人間は好きな時に人の暮らしに踏み込むもんだ。
Hollow Serenity#088.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#089.src: And I'm too weak to stop you. You've got all of that strong gear on you, and I barely know a lick of magic. We're not on equal footing.
Hollow Serenity#089.dst: それに俺は弱い。お前は強い装備を身に着けてるし、俺は魔法なんてろくに使えん。対等じゃない。
Hollow Serenity#089.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#090.src: So... don't go in, but I won't stop you if you do anyways.
Hollow Serenity#090.dst: だから…入るな。まあ、入るなら止めはしないが。
Hollow Serenity#090.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#091.src: No clue who that is. If someone like that lived here, then they're dead.
Hollow Serenity#091.dst: 誰だか知らん。そんな奴が住んでたなら、もう死んでる。
Hollow Serenity#091.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#092.src: Ask someone else about him if you want; I don't really care about this Garvan guy you're looking for.
Hollow Serenity#092.dst: 聞きたきゃ他の奴に聞け。お前が探してる Garvan とかいう奴には興味ない。
Hollow Serenity#092.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#093.src: Hey, you! Got any money? If you give me {~} Liquified Emeralds, I'll give you a spot of dust from the underside of my floorboards!
Hollow Serenity#093.dst: おい、そこのお前！金あるか？液体エメラルド {~} 個くれたら、うちの床板の裏の埃をひとつまみやるぜ！
Hollow Serenity#093.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#094.dst: ない？ちぇっ…つまんねえ。
Hollow Serenity#094.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#096.src: I'm Bip! Yeah, Bip! The greatest guy to ever grace the entertainment industry!
Hollow Serenity#096.dst: 俺は Bip！そう、Bip だ！芸能界に輝いた史上最高の男さ！
Hollow Serenity#096.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#097.src: Oh... I was... Man, I miss my glory days! I used to be a big time man, you know? I was living it up in {p}, but now I have to live in this dump!
Hollow Serenity#097.dst: ああ…俺はな…くそ、栄光の日々が恋しいぜ！昔は大物だったんだ。{p} で派手に暮らしてたのに、今じゃこのゴミ溜め暮らしだ！
Hollow Serenity#097.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#098.src: Damn this world! I blame them for all of this! Everything has been nothing but trouble after trouble. Now everyone can't see how much of an honest guy I am!
Hollow Serenity#098.dst: この世界め！全部あいつらのせいだ！トラブル続きでろくなことがねえ。今じゃ誰も俺がどれだけ正直者か分かっちゃくれねえ！
Hollow Serenity#098.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#099.src: B-BE QUIET! I don't like living here, so don't remind me!
Hollow Serenity#099.dst: だ、だまれ！ここに住むのは嫌なんだから思い出させんな！
Hollow Serenity#099.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#100.src: I don't even truly have my own place! I've gotta live with some crony who owns the house I'm staying in right now.
Hollow Serenity#100.dst: 自分の家すらねえんだぞ！今いる家の持ち主の取り巻き野郎と一緒に住むしかねえ。
Hollow Serenity#100.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#101.src: One day, I'll get out of here, though! I'll be a big time man again, and I'll reclaim my status in society, just you wait!
Hollow Serenity#101.dst: でもいつかここを出てやる！また大物になって、社会での地位を取り戻すんだ、見てろよ！
Hollow Serenity#101.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#102.src: Rumors? Do I look like a gossiper to you??
Hollow Serenity#102.dst: 噂？俺がゴシップ好きに見えるか？？
Hollow Serenity#102.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#103.src: Well, human... I'm an honest entertainer, so don't worry. Good 'ole Bip will tell you a bit of something!
Hollow Serenity#103.dst: まあな、人間…俺は正直な芸人だ、心配すんな。この Bip 様がちょいと教えてやるよ！
Hollow Serenity#103.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#104.src: So, apparently there's a WITCH... living in LEXDALE! OOOOOO, spooky...
Hollow Serenity#104.dst: なんとな、LEXDALE に…魔女が住んでるんだ！うぉぉぉ、こええ…
Hollow Serenity#104.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#105.src: But the thing is, she's causing... the Decay... dun dun DUUUN!!! Uhh... I don't know, her house is decaying, or something.
Hollow Serenity#105.dst: でもな、そいつが…腐朽を…引き起こしてる…ジャジャジャーン！！！えーと…知らねえ、家が腐ってるとかそんなんだ。
Hollow Serenity#105.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#106.src: So now, she's gonna die. The end! Didja like that story, human? Every relation to in-real life people was {~} intentional, 'cuz this is actually happening.
Hollow Serenity#106.dst: で、そいつは死ぬ。おしまい！どうだ人間、面白かったか？実在の人物との関係は {~} 意図的だぜ、だってこれ実話だからな。
Hollow Serenity#106.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#107.src: Oh yeah! That's the name of the guy who FIRED ME! DAMMIT!!!-
Hollow Serenity#107.dst: おお知ってる！俺をクビにした奴の名前だ！ちくしょう！！！――
Hollow Serenity#107.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#108.src: ...Oh, wait, no. Sorry human, I was thinking about Gavin. I don't know who this Garvan guy is! Ask someone else; I can't entertain you with that knowledge.
Hollow Serenity#108.dst: …あ、待て、違う。悪い人間、Gavin のことだった。Garvan なんて知らねえ！他の奴に聞け、その話じゃ楽しませてやれねえ。
Hollow Serenity#108.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#112.dst: Runo だ。ここに住んでる。
Hollow Serenity#112.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#116.src: {p} apparently has something hidden inside of it.
Hollow Serenity#116.dst: {p} の中には何かが隠されてるらしい。
Hollow Serenity#116.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#117.src: The chains have something to do with it.
Hollow Serenity#117.dst: 鎖が関係してるらしい。
Hollow Serenity#117.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#118.src: I dunno what else to say.
Hollow Serenity#118.dst: 他に何を言えばいいか分からん。
Hollow Serenity#118.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#119.src: ...You know what? Neither do you! You've said, like, {~} sentences in the last {~} minutes!
Hollow Serenity#119.dst: …あのな、お前だってそうだろ！{~} 文くらいしか喋ってないぞ、ここ {~} 分で！
Hollow Serenity#119.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#120.src: I just don't like talking, sheesh! My voice gets way more tense if I don't keep my words short. And it hurts.
Hollow Serenity#120.dst: 喋るのが嫌いなだけだ、ったく！言葉を短くしないと声が張り詰めて、痛むんだよ。
Hollow Serenity#120.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#121.src: What, are you offended? Well, I am, too! You'd be mad if some random human walked into your village and egged you into damaging your vocal chords!
Hollow Serenity#121.dst: 何だ、気を悪くしたか？俺もだよ！知らない人間が村に来て、声帯を痛めるまで喋らせようとしたら、お前だって怒るだろ！
Hollow Serenity#121.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#123.src: ...You poor soul. Go buy one. Unless you're one of those guys who owns those flying land bits.
Hollow Serenity#123.dst: …かわいそうに。買えよ。空飛ぶ土地の欠片を持ってる連中の一人なら別だが。
Hollow Serenity#123.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#125.src: He knows most of the things here.
Hollow Serenity#125.dst: ここのことは大体知ってる。
Hollow Serenity#125.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#126.src: Huh, weird. Whatcha doing all the way out here, human? We don't see a lot of your kind often.
Hollow Serenity#126.dst: へえ、珍しい。こんな所まで何しに来たんだ、人間？あんたらみたいなのは滅多に見ないぜ。
Hollow Serenity#126.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#127.dst: 何か言いたいことあるか？
Hollow Serenity#127.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#128.src: My name's Vera. I'm a farmer, but you probably already guessed that. That's all this damn village is good for anyways.
Hollow Serenity#128.dst: 俺は Vera。農夫だ、まあ見りゃ分かるか。このクソ村はそれしか取り柄がないからな。
Hollow Serenity#128.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#129.src: I also deal with getting supplies from other towns! Pretty cool, huh?
Hollow Serenity#129.dst: 他の町から物資を仕入れる仕事もしてるんだ！かっこいいだろ？
Hollow Serenity#129.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#130.src: Uhh... all my life, actually! Too damn poor to go anywhere else, so I've just hunkered down here and decided to stick it out until I'm dead.
Hollow Serenity#130.dst: えーと…実は生まれてからずっと！貧乏すぎてどこにも行けないから、ここに腰を据えて死ぬまで耐えることにしたんだ。
Hollow Serenity#130.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#131.src: It's bad, living out here, but once you get used to it some of the edge is taken off. This village is all I've really known, and I owe it to everyone here to stick around, you know what I mean?
Hollow Serenity#131.dst: ここでの暮らしはきついけど、慣れれば少しはマシになる。この村しか知らないし、みんなに恩があるから離れられない、分かるだろ？
Hollow Serenity#131.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#132.src: Still... adventuring sounds like fun, sometimes... The furthest I've ever gone from here is halfway through {p} County.
Hollow Serenity#132.dst: でも…冒険って楽しそうだと思う時もあるんだ…一番遠くまで行ったのは {p} 郡の半分くらいまでさ。
Hollow Serenity#132.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#133.src: I bet you have some pretty good stories to tell from adventuring, ain't that right human?
Hollow Serenity#133.dst: 冒険の面白い話、たくさんあるんだろ？なあ人間？
Hollow Serenity#133.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#134.src: You know the massive prison near {p}? Yeah, the {p}.
Hollow Serenity#134.dst: {p} の近くのでかい監獄、知ってるか？そう、{p}だ。
Hollow Serenity#134.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#135.src: So, apparently... the place is actually really corrupt. They arrest innocent people every other day, and they never come back out.
Hollow Serenity#135.dst: でな、あそこは実はかなり腐敗してるらしい。無実の人を毎日のように捕まえて、誰も出てこないんだ。
Hollow Serenity#135.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#136.src: Gavel's government hasn't done anything about it, but everyone in the forest knows damn well something shady is going on there. I'd watch myself around that place if I were you!
Hollow Serenity#136.dst: Gavel の政府は何もしないけど、森の奴らはみんな、あそこで何か怪しいことが起きてるって分かってる。俺ならあの辺じゃ気をつけるね！
Hollow Serenity#136.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#137.src: ...Should you tell him about the prison?
Hollow Serenity#137.dst: …監獄の事を話すべきだろうか?

Hollow Serenity#139.src: Get to talking, human! You can't just leave off like that! Tell me, are the rumors about that place true?
Hollow Serenity#139.dst: 話せよ、人間！そこで止めるなって！教えてくれ、あそこの噂は本当なのか？
Hollow Serenity#139.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#142.src: Oh my word... and you saw it with your own eyes?
Hollow Serenity#142.dst: なんてこった…自分の目で見たのか？
Hollow Serenity#142.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#143.src: Human... thanks for letting me know. You gotta tell more people about this, though! You could probably publish a book about it once you spread the word! You'd be rich!
Hollow Serenity#143.dst: 人間…教えてくれてありがとな。でもこのこと、もっと多くの人に伝えなきゃ！噂が広まったら本だって出せるかもな！大金持ちだぜ！
Hollow Serenity#143.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#144.src: ...Well, I'm not gonna believe you if you're saying it all forced like that, you know.
Hollow Serenity#144.dst: …まあ、そんな無理やりな言い方じゃ信じないけどな。
Hollow Serenity#144.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#145.src: I won't push it, though; it was probably just too awful to talk about, right? You don't have to go into detail if you don't wanna.
Hollow Serenity#145.dst: でも無理には聞かないよ。きっと口にするのもつらいほどひどかったんだろ？話したくなきゃ詳しく話さなくていい。
Hollow Serenity#145.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#146.src: Just stay well away from that place, and make sure nobody else goes near there, alright?
Hollow Serenity#146.dst: とにかくあそこには近づくな。他の奴も近づかせないようにしてくれ、いいな？
Hollow Serenity#146.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#147.src: Uh... no. That doesn't ring a single bell.
Hollow Serenity#147.dst: えー…いや。全然ピンとこない。
Hollow Serenity#147.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#148.src: You could probably ask some other people, though! I'm only the youngest guy in the village, so the older people here would probably know who this Garvan guy is!
Hollow Serenity#148.dst: でも他の人に聞いてみればいいさ！俺は村で一番若いから、年寄り連中ならその Garvan って奴を知ってるかもな！
Hollow Serenity#148.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#149.src: S-Sheesh! You scared me, human! Don't you know that you shouldn't walk into people's houses out of nowhere?
Hollow Serenity#149.dst: び、びっくりした！驚かさないでよ人間！いきなり人の家に入っちゃダメって知らないの？
Hollow Serenity#149.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#150.src: You know there are creepy guys out here who rob people like that? You should be more careful!
Hollow Serenity#150.dst: 外にはそうやって強盗する変な奴もいるんだよ？もっと気をつけなきゃ！
Hollow Serenity#150.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#152.src: I'm nobody. No, I'm serious, I literally don't have a name. Parents just didn't bother to name me.
Hollow Serenity#152.dst: 私は名無し。いや本当に名前がないの。親が名前をつける手間を惜しんだんだ。
Hollow Serenity#152.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#153.src: Apparently that's considered sacrilegious around here, so I was taken away from them and I now work for Pastor Arwes.
Hollow Serenity#153.dst: ここじゃそれが冒涜らしくて、親から引き離されて、今は Arwes 牧師のところで働いてるの。
Hollow Serenity#153.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#154.src: What do the others call me? Uhh... Big-nosed girl. Yeah, I know, a bit on the nose–
Hollow Serenity#154.dst: みんなからの呼び名？えーと…デカ鼻娘。うん、分かってる、そのまんま――
Hollow Serenity#154.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#155.src: ...That sailed right over my head. But it's true, though! I have the biggest nose in the village.
Hollow Serenity#155.dst: …今のは全然分かんなかった。でも本当なんだよ！村で一番鼻が大きいのは私。
Hollow Serenity#155.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#156.src: What should you call me? Hm... I don't know... maybe... Eua?
Hollow Serenity#156.dst: 何て呼べばいいか？うーん…分かんない…じゃあ…Eua とか？
Hollow Serenity#156.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#157.src: I know it won't matter anymore, but sure. Call me Eua. That sounds like a nice name.
Hollow Serenity#157.dst: もう意味ないのは分かってるけど、いいよ。Eua って呼んで。いい名前だと思う。
Hollow Serenity#157.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#158.src: This one's not necessarily a rumor, but... have you ever heard of someone that they call the Wanderer?
Hollow Serenity#158.dst: これは噂ってわけじゃないけど…「放浪者」って呼ばれてる人の話、聞いたことある？
Hollow Serenity#158.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#159.src: He's a weird guy who just... wanders. He's completely despondent, and doesn't really interact with anyone. Even a lot of the dangerous creatures around here just tend to ignore his presence. He's almost like... a ghost.
Hollow Serenity#159.dst: ただ…さまよってるだけの変な人。すっかり生気がなくて、誰とも関わらないの。この辺の危ない生き物ですら、その存在を無視しちゃうんだ。まるで…幽霊みたい。
Hollow Serenity#159.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#160.src: You've probably seen him before in the forest. Hooded guy, doesn't talk at all? That's who they call the Wanderer.
Hollow Serenity#160.dst: 森で見かけたことあるかもね。フードを被って全然喋らない人？それが放浪者だよ。
Hollow Serenity#160.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#161.src: Well, he doesn't really hurt anyone, so I don't really worry about him too much, but still... it's spooky...
Hollow Serenity#161.dst: まあ、誰も傷つけないからそこまで心配はしてないけど、でも…不気味だよね…
Hollow Serenity#161.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#162.src: Wait, THAT manor? Nah. No one goes near there anymore, not since it was abandoned. What, do you not know what happened there?
Hollow Serenity#162.dst: 待って、「あの」屋敷？ないない。廃屋になってから誰も近づかないよ。え、あそこで何があったか知らないの？
Hollow Serenity#162.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#163.src: It used to be owned by a family of nobles called the Faltachs. Big, important people in the forest, very rich.
Hollow Serenity#163.dst: 昔は Faltach っていう貴族の一家のものだったの。森の大物で、すごいお金持ち。
Hollow Serenity#163.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#164.src: Well... a lot of stuff happened with them. The mistress of the family supposedly went insane and killed her husband at some point, or something like that...
Hollow Serenity#164.dst: で…いろいろあったんだよ。奥様が気が狂って、いつだか旦那さんを殺したとか、そんな話…
Hollow Serenity#164.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#165.src: There's a lot to unpack there, human. And you honestly shouldn't unpack it.
Hollow Serenity#165.dst: 掘り返すと色々出てくるよ、人間。正直、掘り返さないほうがいい。
Hollow Serenity#165.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#166.src: Hmm... No, can't say I have. Whoever this person is, they certainly don't live here.
Hollow Serenity#166.dst: うーん…ううん、聞いたことない。誰だか知らないけど、ここには住んでないよ。
Hollow Serenity#166.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#167.src: And nah, it's not me, either, even if I don't have a real name. I wouldn't even be here if my parents had named me something manly like Garvan anyways.
Hollow Serenity#167.dst: それに私でもないよ、本名がなくてもね。親が Garvan みたいな男らしい名前をつけてたら、そもそもここにいないし。
Hollow Serenity#167.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#168.src: Ask around, though! I'm sure others probably know him.
Hollow Serenity#168.dst: でも聞いて回ってみて！きっと誰か知ってるよ。
Hollow Serenity#168.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#169.src: You're new... we don't see a lot of youngsters around these days... especially humans.
Hollow Serenity#169.dst: 見ない顔じゃな…近頃は若いのは滅多に来ん…特に人間はな。
Hollow Serenity#169.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#171.src: Very on the nose, whippersnapper. My name is Lokno. I'm what's left of this town during its olden days...
Hollow Serenity#171.dst: ずいぶん直球じゃな、若造。わしは Lokno。この町の古き日々の生き残りじゃよ…
Hollow Serenity#171.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#172.src: Mhm. This village... has definitely seen better days. This Decay stuff has ruined us, just take a look around! Nothing here has been suitable for living for over {~} years...
Hollow Serenity#172.dst: うむ。この村も…昔はもっと良かった。腐朽のせいで何もかも駄目になった、見回してみい！もう {~} 年以上、住めた場所ではないわい…
Hollow Serenity#172.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#173.src: Hah... well, right now, it's a crowd of shacks, but before the Decay came along, we used to do great...
Hollow Serenity#173.dst: はは…今はあばら屋の寄せ集めじゃが、腐朽が来る前はそりゃ栄えとった…
Hollow Serenity#173.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#174.src: We always had enough food to go around, we could sell off what we didn't need to eat, and everything was thriving.
Hollow Serenity#174.dst: 食い物はいつも皆に行き渡り、余った分は売れて、何もかもが豊かじゃった。
Hollow Serenity#174.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#175.src: My great-grandmother, Aki, always told me stories about this place. Our little village. I wish I could have been around to live in it then.
Hollow Serenity#175.dst: 曾祖母の Aki がよくこの場所の話をしてくれた。わしらの小さな村のな。その頃に生きていたかったもんじゃ。
Hollow Serenity#175.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#176.src: She was always convinced though... that if the rightful rulers of Gavel returned, all of these issues could easily be squashed.
Hollow Serenity#176.dst: だが曾祖母はいつも信じとった…Gavel の正統な統治者が戻れば、こんな問題はすぐ片付くとな。
Hollow Serenity#176.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#177.src: To be honest... I believe the same. The government has abandoned us. So... why not bring back the old one?
Hollow Serenity#177.dst: 正直…わしもそう思う。政府はわしらを見捨てた。なら…昔の統治者を呼び戻せばよかろう？
Hollow Serenity#177.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#178.src: I may not be the most religious villager around here, but it would feel more right to be ruled by someone who has the heavens' approval.
Hollow Serenity#178.dst: わしは信心深い方ではないが、天に認められた者に治められる方がしっくりくるのう。
Hollow Serenity#178.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#179.src: Nope. I don't deal with that kind of stuff, bahaha! Sorry human; you're out of luck.
Hollow Serenity#179.dst: ないのう。そういうのには関わらんのじゃ、ばっはっは！すまんな人間、運がなかったの。
Hollow Serenity#179.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#180.src: G... Garvan... yes. I know that name.
Hollow Serenity#180.dst: G…Garvan…ああ。その名は知っとる。
Hollow Serenity#180.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#181.src: He isn't here, though. I don't know his whereabouts, what he's doing, or if he's even alive. He's... just nonexistant.
Hollow Serenity#181.dst: だがここにはおらん。居場所も、何をしとるかも、生きとるかすら分からん。まるで…存在せんようじゃ。
Hollow Serenity#181.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#182.src: I don't know why you're chasing after him, but... if you want a place to start, look at the abandoned laboratory on top of that hill, just west to the of here.
Hollow Serenity#182.dst: なぜ追っとるかは知らんが…手がかりが欲しいなら、ここのすぐ西、丘の上の廃研究所を見てみい。
Hollow Serenity#182.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#183.src: Fair warning, though... My great-grandmother is the only reason I know about him, and even then... she was always put off by him, and told me to stay away from him. I'd be wary, if I were you.
Hollow Serenity#183.dst: ただし忠告しとく…わしが奴を知っとるのは曾祖母のおかげじゃが、その曾祖母も…奴を嫌っとって、近づくなとわしに言っとった。わしなら用心するのう。
Hollow Serenity#183.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#184.src: Or don't. He sounds like a nice man. You're strong, as well. I'm sure you'll be fine.
Hollow Serenity#184.dst: いや、せんでもいい。いい男らしいしの。お前さんも強い。きっと大丈夫じゃろ。
Hollow Serenity#184.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#185.src: Investigate the contents of the abandoned laboratory at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Hollow Serenity#185.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の廃研究所の中を調べる

Hollow Serenity#187.src: Return to the Faltach Manor and find the entrance to the secret study at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hollow Serenity#187.dst: Faltach 屋敷に戻り、[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の隠し書斎の入口を探す。

Hollow Serenity#188.src: Uncover the secrets of the study.

Hollow Serenity#189.src: It's an excerpt from Yorman's Journal...
Hollow Serenity#189.dst: これはYormanの日記からの抜粋だ…

Hollow Serenity#190.src: ...What the hell is my wife THINKING?? Defending Garvan, as much of a lunatic as he is??
Hollow Serenity#190.dst: …妻は一体何を考えているんだ?? あれほど頭がおかしいGarvanを擁護するなんて??

Hollow Serenity#191.src: The man's made so little progress in the past few years. At this point, it's just a waste of our wealth...
Hollow Serenity#191.dst: この男はここ数年、ほとんど進展が見られない。もはや、私たちの財産を無駄にしているだけだ……

Hollow Serenity#192.src: Why is she defending HIM?? She's always been like that, so hopeful and defensive of the scientist... what could she POSSIBLY see in him?
Hollow Serenity#192.dst: なんで彼女はあいつを擁護してるの??彼女は昔からそうだったよね、いつも希望に満ちていて、あの科学者を必死に擁護して……一体あいつのどこに魅力を感じてるの?

Hollow Serenity#193.src: Unless... No. That is impossible. She is not... like that. Damn it, I might be in the need for some well-deserved sleep...
Hollow Serenity#193.dst: まさか……いや、そんなはずはない。彼女は……そんな人じゃない。くそっ、そろそろしっかり眠ったほうがいいかもしれない……

Hollow Serenity#194.src: Upon closer inspection, this bookshelf actually appears to be a false panel. You can see a room behind it, as well.
Hollow Serenity#194.dst: よく見ると、この本棚は実際には見掛けだけのパネルのようだ。その向こうに部屋が見える。

Hollow Serenity#195.src: It's a small notes page that Garvan appeared to have written...
Hollow Serenity#195.dst: Garvanが書いたと思われる、小さなメモの一部だ……

Hollow Serenity#196.src: Hmmm... Odd. There's a lot to take in here relating to Gavel's deceased monarchy. It's quite interesting, though there is nothing about the Gerten War.
Hollow Serenity#196.dst: うーん……奇妙だな。Gavelの滅亡した君主制に関しては、ここで取り上げられていることがたくさんある。かなり興味深い内容だが、Gerten戦争については何も書かれていない。

Hollow Serenity#197.src: There are a few philosophical books that dive deep into the divide that the Cinfrasian Uprising has caused within the province. Very... strong opinions indeed.
Hollow Serenity#197.dst: Cinfrasian Uprisingが州内に引き起こした分断について深く掘り下げた哲学書がいくつかある。実に……強烈な意見ばかりだ。

Hollow Serenity#198.src: The Decay has certainly drowned out that conflict. I myself have never heard of any of this! Though again, I never was a lover of history in the first place.
Hollow Serenity#198.dst: 腐朽は確かにその対立を覆い隠してしまった。私自身、こうした話は一度も聞いたことがない!とはいえ、そもそも私は歴史好きではなかったのだが。

Hollow Serenity#199.src: Huh. One of the more recent books suggests something has resurfaced in Kander. Villagers are ordered to keep an eye on their neighbors...
Hollow Serenity#199.dst: ふむ。最近出版された本の一冊によると、Kanderで何かが再び姿を現したらしい。村人たちは隣人を監視するよう命じられている……

Hollow Serenity#200.src: I should ask Katarin about this. She'd likely know more than I about any remaining royal politics, no?
Hollow Serenity#200.dst: この件についてはKatarinに聞いてみるべきだな。残っている王室の政治事情については、彼女の方が私より詳しいだろう?

Hollow Serenity#201.src: Well, it's a clock. Some of its components appear to be missing, though.
Hollow Serenity#201.dst: まあ、時計だ。ただ、部品がいくつか欠けているようだ。

Hollow Serenity#202.src: They must be around here somewhere. Maybe if you can find them, you'll be able to use the clock.
Hollow Serenity#202.dst: きっとこの辺りのどこかにあるはずだ。もしそれを見つければ、この時計を使えるようになるかもしれない。

Hollow Serenity#203.src: There's some sort of riddle etched onto the door's surface...
Hollow Serenity#203.dst: ドアの表面には、何かなぞなぞのようなものが刻まれている……

Hollow Serenity#204.src: "You died at {~} o-clock that night. Only {~} people came to your funeral.
Hollow Serenity#204.dst: 「あなたはその夜、{~}時に亡くなりました。葬儀にはたった{~}人しか参列しませんでした。

Hollow Serenity#205.src: {~} of them couldn't have cared less. The other person wept for {~} hours afterwards."
Hollow Serenity#205.dst: そのうち{~}人は全く気にも留めなかった。もう一人はその後、{~}時間も泣き続けた。」

Hollow Serenity#206.src: Investigate the unlocked room in the study.
Hollow Serenity#206.dst: 書斎の鍵の開いた部屋を調べる。

Hollow Serenity#207.src: It's more clear. Day by day. This pestilence. Clear. Clear.
Hollow Serenity#207.dst: だんだんはっきりしてきた。日ごとに。この疫病が。はっきり。はっきり。

Hollow Serenity#208.src: The creatures that cause this... and their wellspring... are sent by something beyond my comprehension.
Hollow Serenity#208.dst: これを引き起こす存在……そしてその源……は、私の理解を超える何者かによって送り込まれたものだ。

Hollow Serenity#209.src: Yes. Yes yes yes yes yes yes yes yes yes yes yes yes yes yes yes yes. The Decay has been... brought here by divine intervention.
Hollow Serenity#209.dst: Yes. Yes yes yes yes yes yes yes yes yes yes yes yes yes yes yes yes. 腐朽は……神の御業によって、ここに連れてこられたのです。

Hollow Serenity#210.src: Then... I will use the divine's sentries to cure this. Just as they suggested.
Hollow Serenity#210.dst: それなら……神の守護者を使ってこれを治そう。彼らが提案した通りに。

Hollow Serenity#211.src: I will begin at my research outpost in that stone city of {p}. I'll bring her there.
Hollow Serenity#211.dst: 私は、あの石造りの街、{p}で調査を始めるつもりだ。彼女をそこに連れて行くつもりだ。

Hollow Serenity#212.src: And all of this will finally end. By a cure.
Hollow Serenity#212.dst: そして、これらすべてはいつか終わりを迎えるでしょう。治療法が見つかることで。

Hollow Serenity#213.src: So there's a research outpost in what you assume is now Old {p}...? It might be worth it to go investigate that outpost for anything useful.
Hollow Serenity#213.dst: つまり、今でいうOld {p}と思われる場所に、研究基地があるということか……？　その研究基地に行って、何か役に立つものがないか調べてみる価値はあるかもしれない。

Hollow Serenity#214.src: ...It seems that the exit has been opened up.
Hollow Serenity#214.dst: どうやら出口が開いたようだ。

Hollow Serenity#215.src: This apparition before you isn't doing anything, though. Maybe you could try talking to it?
Hollow Serenity#215.dst: でも、目の前にいるこの幽霊は、何もしていないようだ。話しかけてみてはどうだろうか？

Hollow Serenity#216.src: That spirit didn't open the door? Then... what did? Or... who did?
Hollow Serenity#216.dst: その幽霊が扉を開けなかったのか？　それなら……何が開けたんだ？　それとも……誰が開けたんだ？

Hollow Serenity#217.src: You need to leave the study.
Hollow Serenity#217.dst: この書斎から出て行った方がよさそうだ。

Hollow Serenity#219.src: As you fall deeper into unconsciousness, a vision of the past begins to form in your mind...
Hollow Serenity#219.dst: 意識がますます遠のくにつれて、過去の光景が頭の中に浮かび始めてくる……

Hollow Serenity#220.src: Dammit, Katarin! I'm not dealing with that loonie anymore! It's been years since I hired that scientist, and he STILL has nothing! If he doesn't find a cure soon, then I'll just get rid of him!
Hollow Serenity#220.dst: いい加減にしろ、Katarin！あの狂人の相手はもう御免だ！あの科学者を雇って何年経つ、なのにまだ成果ゼロだ！すぐに治療法を見つけられんなら、始末してやる！
Hollow Serenity#220.speaker: Yorman

Hollow Serenity#221.src: Y-Yorman, you can't be serious! What we're asking him to do is heavily unresearched, firing him for taking time on that wouldn't be a good idea!
Hollow Serenity#221.dst: Y、Yorman、本気じゃないでしょう！彼に頼んでいるのは誰も研究していないことよ、時間がかかるからって解雇するのは良くないわ！
Hollow Serenity#221.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#222.src: Woman, have you SEEN the state that cretin is in?? Even if it does take long, he's in no damn shape to deal with it! Now stop arguing with me, and help me get rid of him--
Hollow Serenity#222.dst: 女、あの馬鹿の有様を見たのか？？時間がかかるにしても、あいつはまともに扱える状態じゃない！もう口答えするな、あいつを追い払うのを手伝え――
Hollow Serenity#222.speaker: Yorman

Hollow Serenity#224.src: This is too far, Yorman! Garvan MUST stay! You will do this if you still love me!
Hollow Serenity#224.dst: やりすぎよ、Yorman！Garvan は残さなきゃ駄目！まだ私を愛しているなら、そうして！
Hollow Serenity#224.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#225.src: ...Why do you even care so much?? Some lunatic scientist like him isn't good for anybody! We both know that we'd save more time and money by letting him run off!
Hollow Serenity#225.dst: …なぜそこまで気にかける？？あんな狂った科学者は誰のためにもならん！出て行かせた方が時間も金も節約できると、お互い分かってるだろう！
Hollow Serenity#225.speaker: Yorman

Hollow Serenity#226.src: I still have faith in him, unlike you! I'll talk to him to see what's going on if I must, but I will NOT tolerate you throwing him out simply because you're too eager for results!
Hollow Serenity#226.dst: あなたと違って、私はまだ彼を信じてるの！必要なら私が話して様子を確かめる、でも結果を急ぐあまり彼を追い出すなんて、絶対に許さないわ！
Hollow Serenity#226.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#227.src: Fine. But know this; I will see to it MYSELF that his head is taken off of his shoulders if that man continues to waste my time, understand??
Hollow Serenity#227.dst: いいだろう。だが覚えておけ。あの男がこれ以上時間を無駄にするなら、首が胴から離れるのを俺自ら見届けてやる、分かったな？？
Hollow Serenity#227.speaker: Yorman

Hollow Serenity#228.src: ...I'm leaving to take care of some matters in {p}. Ask one of the maids to make sure that Eileen goes to bed. I'll be back before midnight.
Hollow Serenity#228.dst: …{p} で用事を片付けてくる。メイドに Eileen を寝かせるよう言っておけ。真夜中までには戻る。
Hollow Serenity#228.speaker: Yorman

Hollow Serenity#229.src: ...That... was close... I can't have him getting between us anymore.
Hollow Serenity#229.dst: …危なかった…もうあの人に私たちの邪魔はさせない。
Hollow Serenity#229.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#230.src: I-I am here, Katarin. You wished to s-speak with me...?
Hollow Serenity#230.dst: き、来たよ、Katarin。わ、私に話があると…？
Hollow Serenity#230.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#231.src: Yes, love. Yorman is becoming suspicious of you. He thinks that you're not making any progress on the cure and wasting his time. Any more of this, and he may attempt to get rid of you.
Hollow Serenity#231.dst: ええ、あなた。Yorman があなたを疑い始めてる。治療法の研究が進まず、時間を無駄にしてると思ってるの。このままだと、あなたを消そうとするかもしれない。
Hollow Serenity#231.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#232.src: I just wanted to check on you, love. Are... you doing alright? Is your work coming along well?
Hollow Serenity#232.dst: 様子を見に来たかったの、あなた。その…大丈夫？研究は順調？
Hollow Serenity#232.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#245.src: F-Fine. I am fine. I appreciate the concern, but... It truly is u-unwarranted. I'm q-quite close to finding a cure to this disease, y-yes.
Hollow Serenity#245.dst: だ、大丈夫だ。私は大丈夫。心配はありがたいが…本当にひ、必要ない。病の治療法はも、もうすぐ見つかる、そ、そうだ。
Hollow Serenity#245.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#246.src: Ah! That is good to hear. Now then... How are things? We haven't had many chances to catch up recently.
Hollow Serenity#246.dst: まあ！それは良かった。それで…最近どう？ゆっくり話す機会もなかったわね。
Hollow Serenity#246.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#247.src: ...Wonderful. I've met... many peers. Recently. They give me the strength I need to advance my progress. Now... how is our daughter, Eileen?
Hollow Serenity#247.dst: …素晴らしいよ。最近…多くの仲間に出会った。彼らが研究を進める力をくれる。それで…娘の Eileen はどうだい？
Hollow Serenity#247.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#248.src: She's doing great. She takes a lot after you, actually. Intelligent, beautiful, an inquisitive mind. I just hope this Decay can be dealt with and we don't need to live in fear any longer.
Hollow Serenity#248.dst: 元気よ。実はあなたにそっくりなの。賢くて、美しくて、好奇心旺盛。この腐朽がどうにかなって、もう怯えて暮らさずに済むといいのだけど。
Hollow Serenity#248.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#249.src: Wonderful. And... is our eternal bond safe? The gemstone? Has... Yorman found out about it?
Hollow Serenity#249.dst: 素晴らしい。それで…私たちの永遠の絆は無事かい？あの宝石は？Yorman に…気づかれてはいないか？
Hollow Serenity#249.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#250.src: Yes, it has stayed hidden. As long as it's kept intact, our souls will stay bound to it. You just need to take care of your little project and we'll ride into the sunset, just like you said, mhm?
Hollow Serenity#250.dst: ええ、隠したままよ。あれが無事な限り、私たちの魂はあれに結ばれたまま。あなたは小さな計画を片付けて、言ってた通り夕日の中へ旅立ちましょう、ね？
Hollow Serenity#250.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#252.src: We... I will not risk her life for our love. She has a future in {p}, Garvan! She isn't a part of this and I don't think she—
Hollow Serenity#252.dst: 私たちの…私は、この愛のためにあの子の命を危険にさらさない。あの子には {p} での未来があるのよ、Garvan！あの子は関係ないし、それに――
Hollow Serenity#252.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#253.src: Eileen... She is a shining star in this world. Her noble blood and natural talent makes her something truly special.
Hollow Serenity#253.dst: Eileen…あの子はこの世界に輝く星だ。高貴な血と天賦の才が、あの子を特別な存在にしている。
Hollow Serenity#253.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#254.src: Do you realize, Katarin? Our daughter is a gift from the heavens! Once she has matured, she will accomplish things that Gavel has never seen! Bring back the holy and royal will that was los-
Hollow Serenity#254.dst: 分かるかい、Katarin？私たちの娘は天からの贈り物だ！成長すれば、Gavel が見たこともない偉業を成し遂げる！失われた聖なる王家を取り戻して――
Hollow Serenity#254.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#255.src: ...Forgive me, I-I'm rambling once more. I... must leave now, research calls. Goodbye, my love. Great things will happen, sooner or later.
Hollow Serenity#255.dst: …すまない、ま、また取り留めもなく話してしまった。私は…もう行かねば、研究が待っている。さようなら、愛しい人。いずれ偉大なことが起こる。
Hollow Serenity#255.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#256.dst: 本当にそうだといいわ…
Hollow Serenity#256.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#257.src: Unbeknownst to the Faltach family, Yorman's hunch was correct all along. Their hired scientist had indeed moved away from his original goal.
Hollow Serenity#257.dst: Faltach家には知らされていなかったが、Yormanの直感は最初から正しかった。彼らが雇った科学者は、確かに当初の目標から逸脱していたのだ。
Hollow Serenity#257.speaker: atarin

Hollow Serenity#258.src: During his research, Garvan had come too close into contact with the forest villagers... and was thoroughly broken into subservience.
Hollow Serenity#258.dst: 研究の過程で、Garvanは森の村人たちとあまりにも親密になりすぎてしまい……完全に屈服させられてしまった。
Hollow Serenity#258.speaker: atarin

Hollow Serenity#259.src: Their goals were unclear, but they seemed uninterested in having Garvan continue to truly cure the Decay. Instead, they suggested something far more sinister.
Hollow Serenity#259.dst: 彼らの目的は定かではなかったが、Garvanに腐朽を真に治し続けてもらうことには関心がなさそうだった。その代わりに、彼らははるかに不吉な提案を持ち出した。
Hollow Serenity#259.speaker: atarin

Hollow Serenity#260.src: It seems like someone brought you back to the forest village. You should probably head to Garvan's research outpost in Old {p}.
Hollow Serenity#260.dst: どうやら誰かがあなたを森の村まで連れ戻してくれたようだ。Old {p}にあるガーヴァンの研究前哨基地へ向かうといいだろう。
Hollow Serenity#260.speaker: atarin

Hollow Serenity#261.src: Make your way to Garvan's old research outpost at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hollow Serenity#261.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の Garvan の古い研究拠点へ向かう。

Hollow Serenity#262.src: It seems like someone brought you back to the forest village. You should probably head to Garvan's research outpost in Old {p}.
Hollow Serenity#262.dst: どうやら誰かがあなたを森の村まで連れ戻してくれたようだ。Old {p}にあるガーヴァンの研究前哨基地へ向かうといいだろう。
Hollow Serenity#262.speaker: atarin

Hollow Serenity#263.src: Gather as much pieces of evidence as you can in the research outpost.
Hollow Serenity#263.dst: 研究拠点でできるだけ多くの証拠を集める。

Hollow Serenity#264.src: In order to progress, you must gather pieces of evidence that are surrounded by green particles. You can do this by right-clicking on them.
Hollow Serenity#264.dst: ゲームを進めるには、緑色の粒子に囲まれている証拠の断片を集める必要があります。これを行うには、それらを右クリックしてください。

Hollow Serenity#265.src: Occasionally a wandering intruder will approach the outpost, and will catch you if it sees you. You will have to hide by right-clicking the closets covered in blue particles.
Hollow Serenity#265.dst: 時折、研究拠点にさまよう侵入者が近づいてきて、あなたを見つけると捕まえてしまいます。その場合は、青い粒子で覆われたクローゼットを右クリックして隠れる必要があります。

Hollow Serenity#266.src: You managed to gather all of the evidence in the research outpost! You should review the material you gathered and figure out what Garvan was up to.
Hollow Serenity#266.dst: 研究拠点で、すべての証拠を収集することに成功した！収集した資料を精査し、Garvanが何を企んでいたのかを突き止めよう。

Hollow Serenity#267.dst: 見つけたものを調べる。

Hollow Serenity#268.src: As you begin to sift through your findings, a visualization of what you're reading forms in your mind...
Hollow Serenity#268.dst: 調査結果を精査し始めると、読んでいる内容のイメージが頭の中に浮かび上がってくる……

Hollow Serenity#269.src: Ah... N-now you're finally here. I... need you, my darling. We- no... I can cure this Decay with you.
Hollow Serenity#269.dst: ああ…や、やっと来たね。私には…君が必要なんだ。私たちは――いや…君がいれば腐朽を治せる。
Hollow Serenity#269.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#270.src: W-What do you mean...? I-I don't like this... I-I w-wanna go home. It's getting late and mother-
Hollow Serenity#270.dst: ど、どういう意味…？こ、こんなの嫌…お、おうちに帰りたい。もう遅いし、お母様が――
Hollow Serenity#270.speaker: Eileen

Hollow Serenity#271.src: Ssshhh... This will only take a moment.
Hollow Serenity#271.dst: しーっ…すぐに済むから。
Hollow Serenity#271.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#272.src: W-What is that thing?? M-Mister Garvan, I-I don't understand...
Hollow Serenity#272.dst: あ、あれは何？？Garvan さ、さん、わ、わからないよ…
Hollow Serenity#272.speaker: Eileen

Hollow Serenity#273.src: Hush, my daughter. I-I'm doing this for your s-sake... You'll t-thank me later, once it... g-grows acclimated to you.
Hollow Serenity#273.dst: 静かに、娘よ。き、君のためなんだ…これが君にな、馴染めば…あ、後で感謝するさ。
Hollow Serenity#273.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#275.src: Hello, my love. I-It's... been a while.
Hollow Serenity#275.dst: やあ、愛しい人。ひ、久しぶりだね。
Hollow Serenity#275.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#276.src: You... G-Garvan... Why are you here? And what's happened to Eileen? She has been sick for days!
Hollow Serenity#276.dst: あなた…G、Garvan…なぜここに？Eileen に何があったの？何日も寝込んでるのよ！
Hollow Serenity#276.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#277.src: Mmmm... I... Ha-a-have a bit of a... how should I phrase this... a confession to make.
Hollow Serenity#277.dst: んん…私には…ちょ、ちょっと…何と言えばいいか…打ち明けることがある。
Hollow Serenity#277.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#278.src: W-Well... I-I've done... I've...done Eileen a great service... she will live forever, just like we do. Thanks to what I have done.
Hollow Serenity#278.dst: そ、その…私は…Eileen にすごく良いことをしてあげたんだ…あの子は私たちのように永遠に生きる。私のおかげでね。
Hollow Serenity#278.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#279.src: Y-you... Bound her soul?? Garvan, no, I told you she wasn't part of this!! WHY??
Hollow Serenity#279.dst: あ、あなた…あの子の魂を縛ったの？？Garvan、駄目、あの子は関係ないって言ったでしょう！！なぜ？？
Hollow Serenity#279.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#280.src: No, no no no no. I've done much b-b-better. She has something now. In her brain... Don't worry about the s-sorry state she's in now. The parasite will need time to acclimate to her flesh.
Hollow Serenity#280.dst: いや、いやいやいや。も、もっと良いことだ。あの子の中には今、あるものがいる。脳の中に…今のひ、ひどい状態は気にしなくていい。寄生体が体に馴染むには時間が要るんだ。
Hollow Serenity#280.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#281.src: I-I realized... a cure. My work is done, love... Eileen will be cured. The Decay can be s-stopped. It's wonderful-
Hollow Serenity#281.dst: わ、私は見つけた…治療法を。研究は終わったよ…Eileen は治る。腐朽はと、止められる。素晴らしい――
Hollow Serenity#281.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#282.src: WHAT DID YOU DO TO MY DAUGHTER?? WHAT IS WRONG WITH YOU??
Hollow Serenity#282.dst: 娘に何をしたの？？頭がおかしいんじゃないの？？
Hollow Serenity#282.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#283.src: Aaaahhhmmmm... True... I might have stepped out of line. But it's for the best.
Hollow Serenity#283.dst: あぁぁんん…確かに…一線を越えたかもしれない。だがこれが最善なんだ。
Hollow Serenity#283.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#284.src: OUT OF LINE?? This is too far, Garvan! What even happened to you?? You've been acting like this for so, so long! I-I can't take it anymore!
Hollow Serenity#284.dst: 一線を越えた？？やりすぎよ、Garvan！一体どうしちゃったの？？ずっと、ずっとこうじゃない！も、もう耐えられない！
Hollow Serenity#284.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#285.src: You've changed, Garvan! I-I can't even recognize you anymore!! I'm... I'm DONE! GET OUT! STAY AWAY FROM MY FAMILY!
Hollow Serenity#285.dst: あなたは変わったわ、Garvan！も、もうあなたが分からない！！私は…もう終わりよ！出て行って！家族に近づかないで！
Hollow Serenity#285.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#286.src: You again... W-What do you want from me this time...? You've... already ruined me.
Hollow Serenity#286.dst: また君たちか…こ、今度は何が望みだ…？君たちは…もう私を壊しただろう。
Hollow Serenity#286.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#287.src: It doesn't matter. You've accomplished what we've planned for, and that is perfect. The girl will grow into a suitale leader... Now then, we have some questions for you.
Hollow Serenity#287.dst: どうでもいい。お前は我々の計画を果たした、それで十分だ。あの娘は相応しい指導者に育つだろう…さて、お前に聞きたいことがある。
Hollow Serenity#287.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#288.src: Tell me Garvan... Where is the heir?
Hollow Serenity#288.dst: 言え Garvan…継承者はどこだ？
Hollow Serenity#288.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#289.src: I... will not tell you. I have lost Eileen and my love thanks to you. If I am to lose her... then you shall lose her as well.
Hollow Serenity#289.dst: 私は…言わない。お前たちのせいで Eileen も愛する人も失った。私が彼女を失うなら…お前たちも失うがいい。
Hollow Serenity#289.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#290.src: ...Lunatic. You; take him in. Keep him alive.
Hollow Serenity#290.dst: …狂人め。お前、こいつを連れて行け。生かしておけ。
Hollow Serenity#290.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#292.src: Garvan. Garvan, Garvan. I think there's a misunderstanding here. You are in no place to defy us.
Hollow Serenity#292.dst: Garvan。Garvan、Garvan。何か誤解があるようだな。お前に逆らう立場などない。
Hollow Serenity#292.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#293.src: Now then... You will tell us where the rightful heir to the throne is... No matter the cost.
Hollow Serenity#293.dst: さて…王位の正統な継承者の居場所を教えてもらおう…どんな代償を払ってもな。
Hollow Serenity#293.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#294.src: Return to the Manor and search for any clues as to Eileen's whereabouts at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hollow Serenity#294.dst: 屋敷に戻り、[-{~}, {~}, -{~}] で Eileen の行方の手がかりを探す。

Hollow Serenity#295.src: It seems you've arrived. F-Forgive me... I-I'm not quite used to talking anymore. It's been quite a while.
Hollow Serenity#295.dst: 来たようだね。ゆ、許してくれ…も、もう話すのに慣れていなくてね。随分と長い間だった。

Hollow Serenity#296.src: ...Nevermind. I d-don't want your forgiveness in particular. In fact, w-why do you even care? The forest has died, generations have lived on... and yet... You just had to tear the scar open, didn't you?
Hollow Serenity#296.dst: …いや、いい。き、君に許してほしいわけじゃない。そもそも、な、なぜ気にかける？森は死に、何世代も過ぎた…なのに…君は傷口をこじ開けずにはいられなかったんだな？

Hollow Serenity#297.src: My sins... You do not need to see them... all the things I've done wrong. H-How I destroyed the bonds tying me and my love together.
Hollow Serenity#297.dst: 私の罪…君が見る必要はない…私が犯した過ち全てを。わ、私が愛する人との絆をどう壊したかを。

Hollow Serenity#298.src: ...Y-Yes... I mean her. Katarin. She's watching us as we speak, no? A-and with that, I suppose it's obvious what lies under this veil.
Hollow Serenity#298.dst: …そ、そうだ…彼女のことだ。Katarin。今もこうして私たちを見ているだろう？そ、それなら、このヴェールの下が何かも明らかだろうね。

Hollow Serenity#299.src: Greetings... I-I'm s-sure you're well acquainted with me, by now. I-It was me all along. Quite the- well, it was a predictable twist, I suppose...
Hollow Serenity#299.dst: やあ…も、もう私のことはよく知っているだろう。ず、ずっと私だったんだ。実に――まあ、予想通りの展開だったかな…
Hollow Serenity#299.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#300.src: ...B-But... I take it you don't have the full story. So... so so so so so so... Let me explain to you, human... The bitter end to our shared tale.
Hollow Serenity#300.dst: …だ、だが…君はまだ全てを知らないようだ。だから…だからだからだからだから…話してあげよう、人間…私たちの物語の苦い結末を。
Hollow Serenity#300.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#301.src: AAAAAAAGGGHHH!!!! F-FINE! I-I'll tell you... I-I'll tell y-you where Eileen is...
Hollow Serenity#301.dst: ぐあああああ！！！！わ、分かった！い、言う…E、Eileen の居場所を言う…
Hollow Serenity#301.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#302.src: S-She... is with her mother. At the Faltach Manor. T-That is all. Just s-stop...
Hollow Serenity#302.dst: あ、あの子は…母親と一緒だ。Faltach 屋敷に。そ、それだけだ。も、もうやめてくれ…
Hollow Serenity#302.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#303.src: ...Good. This had better not be a lie. You; tell the others that we are heading there now. Kill everyone at the manor and any witnesses; leave the heir alive.
Hollow Serenity#303.dst: …よし。嘘でなければいいがな。お前、他の者に今から向かうと伝えろ。屋敷の者と目撃者は全員殺せ。継承者は生かしておけ。
Hollow Serenity#303.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#305.src: N-NO! GET BACK HERE! DON'T YOU DARE HARM THEM! I'LL KILL YOU!! DO YOU HEAR ME???
Hollow Serenity#305.dst: や、やめろ！戻ってこい！彼らを傷つけるな！殺してやる！！聞こえてるのか？？？
Hollow Serenity#305.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#306.src: ... M-Mother... why d-do I have to stay here?
Hollow Serenity#306.dst: …お、お母様…ど、どうしてここにいなきゃいけないの？
Hollow Serenity#306.speaker: Eileen

Hollow Serenity#307.src: It's for your own good dear. Now, remember to stay put. Garvan won't be able to use you if you're kept inside of here...
Hollow Serenity#307.dst: あなたのためよ。いい、ここから動かないでね。ここにいれば Garvan もあなたを利用できないから…
Hollow Serenity#307.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#309.src: Yorman won't be bothering us anymore, sweetheart. He wouldn't understand, so... J- just don't worry about what happened to him. It's irrelevant-
Hollow Serenity#309.dst: Yorman はもう私たちを煩わせないわ、いい子ね。あの人には分からないの、だから…あ、あの人に何があったかは気にしないで。関係ないの――
Hollow Serenity#309.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#310.src: L-LADY KATARIN! T-THERE ARE INTRUDERS— AAAAAAHHHHHH!!!
Hollow Serenity#310.dst: K、Katarin 様！し、侵入者が――ぎゃあああ！！！
Hollow Serenity#310.speaker: Servant

Hollow Serenity#311.src: ... Who the hell are you all?
Hollow Serenity#311.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#312.src: Step aside, Katarin Faltach. This will be much simpler if you stand down and tell us where your daughter is.
Hollow Serenity#312.dst: どけ、Katarin Faltach。大人しく引いて娘の居場所を言えば、ずっと簡単に済む。
Hollow Serenity#312.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#313.src: ...Come again? No. YOU WON'T TOUCH HER! GET OUT OF MY SIGHT-
Hollow Serenity#313.dst: …何ですって？嫌よ。あの子には触れさせない！消えなさい――
Hollow Serenity#313.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#314.src: You're not the one making demands here... You all, search the house and find the child.
Hollow Serenity#314.dst: 要求できる立場ではないぞ…お前たち、屋敷を探して子供を見つけろ。
Hollow Serenity#314.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#315.src: There she is. Hmm... it seems that the parasite injection worked well. Garvan wasn't so useless after all.
Hollow Serenity#315.dst: いたぞ。ふむ…寄生体の注入は上手くいったようだ。Garvan も案外役に立ったな。
Hollow Serenity#315.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#316.src: Oh? Too terrified to speak? Worry not, Eileen Faltach. You won't be harmed... too much. You're quite important to us, you see.
Hollow Serenity#316.dst: おや？怖くて声も出ないか？心配するな、Eileen Faltach。傷つけはしない…さほどはな。お前は我々にとって大事なのだ。
Hollow Serenity#316.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#317.src: N-NO! STAY AWAY FROM MY DAUGHTER!
Hollow Serenity#317.dst: や、やめて！娘に近づかないで！
Hollow Serenity#317.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#318.src: You have little choice in the matter, Miss Faltach. Stand your ground.
Hollow Serenity#318.dst: 選択の余地はないぞ、Faltach 夫人。そこを動くな。
Hollow Serenity#318.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#319.src: GET AWAY FROM HER, DO YOU HEAR ME??? RAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAGGGGGGGGHHHHHHH!!!!
Hollow Serenity#319.dst: あの子から離れなさい、聞こえないの？？？うあああああああああああああ！！！！
Hollow Serenity#319.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#320.src: Tch... Some people will never understand what we do for the world. Thank you for protecting us from her, Aki.
Hollow Serenity#320.dst: ちっ…我々が世界のためにしていることを、理解しない者もいる。守ってくれて感謝する、Aki。
Hollow Serenity#320.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#321.src: I will deal with the heir myself. You all can head back to our village. Thank you for your help today.
Hollow Serenity#321.dst: 継承者は私が自ら扱う。お前たちは村へ戻れ。今日は協力に感謝する。
Hollow Serenity#321.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#322.src: ... I should have known. I-I... my love... y-you're gone.
Hollow Serenity#322.dst: …分かっていたはずなのに。わ、私の…愛しい人…き、君は逝ってしまった。
Hollow Serenity#322.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#323.src: DAMN IT! DAMN IT DAMN IT DAMN IT DAMN IT AAAAAALLLL!!!!
Hollow Serenity#323.dst: くそ！くそくそくそ、全部くそったれだあああ！！！！
Hollow Serenity#323.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#324.src: This is... W-why did this have to happen? ... I-I can't... this can't end like this...
Hollow Serenity#324.dst: こんな…な、なぜこうならなきゃいけない？…わ、私は…こんな終わり方はあってはならない…
Hollow Serenity#324.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#325.src: T-This will be enough. You have a wonderful grave, m-my love...
Hollow Serenity#325.dst: こ、これで十分だ。素敵な墓だよ、い、愛しい人…
Hollow Serenity#325.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#326.src: W-We won't be separated, though. I-I will leave our true selves here, as well.
Hollow Serenity#326.dst: だ、だが私たちは離れない。わ、私たちの真の姿もここに残していこう。
Hollow Serenity#326.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#328.src: T-This is our final act of love, K-Katarin... This stone will keep us here. Eternal, and in bliss.
Hollow Serenity#328.dst: こ、これが最後の愛の証だ、K、Katarin…この石が私たちをここに留める。永遠に、至福の中で。
Hollow Serenity#328.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#329.src: I-It's like nothing ever h-happened, right?
Hollow Serenity#329.dst: な、何もなかったみたいだろう？
Hollow Serenity#329.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#330.src: And so it ends here. At the same time, it begins my desperate attempts to flee from my past.
Hollow Serenity#330.dst: こうして、ここで物語は幕を閉じる。同時に、私の過去から逃げ出そうとする必死の試みが、ここから始まる。

Hollow Serenity#331.src: I tried to forget. I tried to forget everything, even my own name. I ignored Katarin's spirit calling out to me, demanding I return to her.
Hollow Serenity#331.dst: 忘れようとした。すべてを忘れようとした。自分の名前さえも。Katarinが私を呼び、自分のもとへ戻れと迫るその声を、私は無視した。

Hollow Serenity#332.src: I became... nothing. A nobody. I had no purpose. I wandered the forest, pretending that nothing had ever gone wrong... Indeed, I had become a Wanderer.
Hollow Serenity#332.dst: 私は……何者でもなくなった。無名の存在だ。生きる目的もなかった。森をさまよいながら、まるで何も問題などなかったかのように振る舞っていた……そう、私は「放浪者」となっていたのだ。

Hollow Serenity#334.src: N-Now you understand. T-this is... all my fault. I have ruined everything. E-everything I touched, I destroyed.
Hollow Serenity#334.dst: い、今なら分かるだろう。こ、これは…全て私のせいだ。全てを壊した。さ、触れたもの全てを壊してきた。
Hollow Serenity#334.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#335.src: Have I not repented enough? Have I not suffered for decades in this god-forsaken forest?? And why did you have to-
Hollow Serenity#335.dst: まだ償いが足りないのか？この神に見放された森で何十年も苦しんでも足りないのか？？それになぜ君は――
Hollow Serenity#335.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#336.src: No... You know too much. B-But I can't kill, not again. I-I can make things right. I-I'm going to fix this. I'm going to fix this. I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to...
Hollow Serenity#336.dst: いや…君は知りすぎた。だ、だがもう殺せない、二度とは。わ、私が正すんだ。これを直すんだ。直すんだ。直すんだ直すんだ直すんだ直すんだ…
Hollow Serenity#336.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#337.src: I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to-
Hollow Serenity#337.dst: 直すんだ直すんだ直すんだ直すんだ直すんだ直すんだ直すんだ直すんだ直すんだ直すんだ直すんだ直すんだ直すんだ直すんだ直すんだ直すんだ直すんだ直すんだ――
Hollow Serenity#337.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#339.src: It seems like Garvan went in the direction of the master bedroom...
Hollow Serenity#339.dst: Garvanは主寝室の方へ行ったようだ……

Hollow Serenity#340.src: Get to the Master Bedroom at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Hollow Serenity#341.src: K-Katarin! My l-love... is that you?
Hollow Serenity#341.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#342.src: My word... I-It is you! I missed you, love... and I'm s-so sorry... for all of this!
Hollow Serenity#342.dst: なんと…き、君だ！会いたかった…そして本当にす、すまない…何もかも！
Hollow Serenity#342.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#343.src: I realize n-now, thanks to this h-human's efforts. What I've done has t-torn us apart... I hurt you and our l-little girl so much...
Hollow Serenity#343.dst: 今なら分かる、このに、人間のおかげで。私のしたことが私たちを引き、引き裂いた…君と幼い娘をあんなに傷つけて…
Hollow Serenity#343.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#344.src: I-I'm so sorry, Katarin! P-Please, forgive me! Let us f-fix all of thi-
Hollow Serenity#344.dst: ほ、本当にすまない、Katarin！ど、どうか許してくれ！全てをな、直そう――
Hollow Serenity#344.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#348.src: What... What do you mean?? Speak, my love! I don't understand.
Hollow Serenity#348.dst: 何…どういう意味だ？？話してくれ、愛しい人！分からない。
Hollow Serenity#348.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#349.src: ...Forgiveness...? You... beg for me... to forgive... you?
Hollow Serenity#349.dst: …許し…？あなたが…私に…許しを…乞うの？
Hollow Serenity#349.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#350.src: I... Yes, yes! P-Please, my love! I-I know I've spent the last century and a half running away from u-us, but...
Hollow Serenity#350.dst: 私は…そう、そうだ！ど、どうか！百五十年も私たちから逃げ続けてきたのは分かっている、でも…
Hollow Serenity#350.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#351.src: It was all my fault, from the beginning! I was wrong! W-We can fix this...! We can make everything go back to normal, j-just like it was before!
Hollow Serenity#351.dst: 最初から全部私のせいだった！私が間違っていた！わ、私たちなら直せる…！全部元通りにできる、む、昔のように！
Hollow Serenity#351.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#352.src: Please, Katarin! A-all I ask is that you forgive me!
Hollow Serenity#352.dst: 頼む、Katarin！わ、私の願いは君の許しだけだ！
Hollow Serenity#352.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#353.src: ...You... You must really have a deathwish-
Hollow Serenity#353.dst: …あなた…よほど死にたいようね――
Hollow Serenity#353.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#354.src: ...Maybe I can... Forgive this. But I need something from you, as well...
Hollow Serenity#354.dst: …許せる…かもしれない。でも、あなたにも一つ頼みがあるの…
Hollow Serenity#354.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#355.src: ...Where is the gemstone? I'd... I'd like to know. And then... I could... forgive... this.
Hollow Serenity#355.dst: …宝石はどこ？私…知りたいの。そうすれば…私は…許せる…かも。
Hollow Serenity#355.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#356.src: O-Oh! Is that all? Of course, my love, I can tell you!
Hollow Serenity#356.dst: あ、ああ！それだけかい？もちろんだ、教えるよ！
Hollow Serenity#356.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#357.src: I-I placed it in the catacombs, right next to where—
Hollow Serenity#357.dst: ち、地下墓所に置いたんだ、ちょうど――
Hollow Serenity#357.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#358.src: W-What... W-WHAT I-IS THISS?? I-I C-CAN'T B-BREATHE! P-PLEASE!!
Hollow Serenity#358.dst: な、何だ…こ、これは何だ？？い、息ができない！た、頼む！！
Hollow Serenity#358.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#359.src: NO!! NO, NO NO NO NO!! HUMAN, H-HELP ME!! KATARIN... K-KATARIIIIINNNNN!!!!
Hollow Serenity#359.dst: いやだ！！いやだいやだ！人間、た、助けて！！Katarin…K、Katarin！！
Hollow Serenity#359.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#360.dst: 私から…あの子を…奪った。
Hollow Serenity#360.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#363.src: ...The catacombs! Katarin must have fled to the catacombs in the basement!
Hollow Serenity#363.dst: …地下墓所だ！Katarinは地下の地下墓所へ逃げ込んだに違いない！

Hollow Serenity#364.src: Head to the Manor's catacombs at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hollow Serenity#364.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の屋敷の地下墓所へ向かう。

Hollow Serenity#366.src: TELL ME WHERE IT IS, GARVAN! I KNOW YOU'RE STILL LISTENING!
Hollow Serenity#366.dst: どこにあるか言いなさい、Garvan！まだ聞いてるのは分かってるのよ！
Hollow Serenity#366.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#367.src: Katarin seems furious. Does she not know exactly where the gemstone is?
Hollow Serenity#367.dst: Katarinは激怒しているようだ。彼女は宝石がどこにあるのか、正確には分かっていないのだろうか？

Hollow Serenity#368.src: ... You know where it is. You need to show her where the gemstone is before she brings this room down on your head.
Hollow Serenity#368.dst: …どこにあるかは分かってる。彼女が部屋ごと君の上に崩れ落ちてくる前に、宝石がどこにあるか彼女に見せてやらねば。

Hollow Serenity#369.src: The gemstone must be underneath this rubble, right?
Hollow Serenity#369.dst: 宝石は、この瓦礫の下にあるはずだよね？

Hollow Serenity#370.src: You knew where it was— Hmm... what did Garvan call you things...?
Hollow Serenity#370.dst: 知ってたのね――ふむ…Garvan はあなたを何て呼んでたかしら…？
Hollow Serenity#370.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#371.src: Right, a human. You knew... that it was just beneath this rubble?
Hollow Serenity#371.dst: そう、人間。知ってたの…この瓦礫のすぐ下にあるって？
Hollow Serenity#371.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#372.src: There it is... Thank you... Now this eternal hell will finally end. After so long...
Hollow Serenity#372.dst: あった…ありがとう…これでこの永遠の地獄もやっと終わる。長かった…
Hollow Serenity#372.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#373.src: Do you hear that? It's the ocean waves... The heavens... They're calling for me—
Hollow Serenity#373.dst: 聞こえる？波の音…天が…私を呼んでいる――
Hollow Serenity#373.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#376.src: OUR LOVE WAS MEANT TO LAST FOREVER.
Hollow Serenity#376.dst: 私たちの愛は、永遠に続く運命だった。
Hollow Serenity#376.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#377.src: INTRUDER. YOU MADE THE WRONG CHOICE.
Hollow Serenity#377.dst: 侵入者よ。お前は間違った選択をした。
Hollow Serenity#377.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#378.src: IF YOU REFUSE TO FORGIVE ME, THEN I WILL SIMPLY ERASE ANY PROOF THAT WE EVER EXISTED.
Hollow Serenity#378.dst: もしあなたが私を許してくれないのなら、私は私たちが存在したことに関する証拠をすべて消し去ってしまおう。
Hollow Serenity#378.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#379.src: AND NOTHING WILL REMEMBER YOU ONCE YOU DISAPPEAR.
Hollow Serenity#379.dst: そして、一度姿を消してしまえば、あなたを思い出す者は誰一人いなくなるだろう。
Hollow Serenity#379.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#387.dst: なんで許してくれないの!?!?
Hollow Serenity#387.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#390.src: NO NO NO NO NO NO
Hollow Serenity#390.dst: いやだ いやだ いやだ いやだ いやだ
Hollow Serenity#390.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#391.src: He's gone... All of this will finally be done...
Hollow Serenity#391.dst: 彼は消えた…これで全て終わる…
Hollow Serenity#391.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#392.src: Thank you, stranger. Thank you for... everything.
Hollow Serenity#392.dst: ありがとう、見知らぬ人。何もかも…ありがとう。
Hollow Serenity#392.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#393.src: Now, I'm... finally free. But... I suppose I still have unfinished business. Before I leave, I must know something.
Hollow Serenity#393.dst: 私は…やっと自由。でも…まだやり残したことがあるわ。去る前に知らなきゃいけないことがあるの。
Hollow Serenity#393.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#394.src: ...What has become of my daughter, Eileen? Has she suffered any more? Or did she escape?
Hollow Serenity#394.dst: …娘の Eileen はどうなったの？まだ苦しんだの？それとも逃げられたの？
Hollow Serenity#394.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#395.src: I must know. Is she okay?
Hollow Serenity#395.dst: 知りたいの。あの子は無事？
Hollow Serenity#395.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#396.src: ...I see. That is... wonderful news. Thank you, human.
Hollow Serenity#396.dst: …そう。それは…素晴らしい知らせね。ありがとう、人間。
Hollow Serenity#396.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#397.dst: もう…行かなきゃ…痛みが…
Hollow Serenity#397.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#398.src: ...The pain is receding... The heavens are calling... for the final time...
Hollow Serenity#398.dst: …痛みが引いていく…天が呼んでいる…これが最後…
Hollow Serenity#398.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#399.src: Goodbye... Thank you human, from the bottom of my heart.
Hollow Serenity#399.dst: さようなら…心からありがとう、人間。
Hollow Serenity#399.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#403.src: NO NO NO NO NO NO NO NOOOOO!!!!!!
Hollow Serenity#403.dst: いやいやいやいやいやああああ！！！！！！
Hollow Serenity#403.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#404.src: traitors!! i will make you all suffffeeerrrr!!!
Hollow Serenity#404.dst: 裏切り者！！全員苦しめてやるううう！！！(高位 Gavel 語で)
Hollow Serenity#404.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#406.src: It... doesn't feel right leaving everything as is. Perhaps you should give Garvan and Katarin a proper burial.
Hollow Serenity#406.dst: このままにしておくのは……なんだか気が引ける。GarvanとKatarinに、きちんとした葬儀を執り行うべきかもしれない。

Hollow Serenity#407.src: Bury Garvan's body in Katarin's incomplete grave.
Hollow Serenity#407.dst: Garvan の遺体を Katarin の未完成の墓に埋める。
